mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_cards ( user_card_id, user_id, card_id, codef_account_credential_id, card_name_from_codef, card_no, issuer_id, display_order, is_active, codef_card_key_hash, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userCardId}, #{userId}, #{cardId}, #{linkId}, #{cardNameFromCodef}, #{cardNo}, #{issuerId}, #{displayOrder}, FALSE, #{codefCardKeyHash}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) )

INSERT INTO user_card_option_selections ( user_card_id, option_group_id, card_id, option_choice_id, selected_at ) VALUES ( #{userCardId}, #{optionGroupId}, #{cardId}, #{optionChoiceId}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE card_id = VALUES(card_id), option_choice_id = VALUES(option_choice_id), selected_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
